Invoice INV-11073 covers a subscription bundle (compute + premium support) sold to Acme IE. It looks like our billing engine split VAT across lines and posted to product revenue GLs rather than a single revenue reclass + VAT payable.

Action items I need:

On Mon, Nov 23, 2026 at 9:45 AM Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com> wrote:
> Grace/Marcus — forwarding Acme's note.

Agree this looks like an allocation issue. Recommendations: 
- Reverse the VAT postings we made on 2026-11-01 (full reversal to suspense).
- Rebook VAT as a single VAT payable line for the bundle, reclass revenue from product GLs to bundled revenue reclass GL so revenue recognition isn't affected.
- Use a temporary suspense GL (4100-SUSP) for the reversal window.

We should mark jurisdiction as IE for the tax memo; Acme's spreadsheet shows the correct EU VAT rates for the period. We'll want a short internal tax memo file for audit.

Grace
